name: Tamarack Ottawa International Marathon
summary: The Tamarack Ottawa International Marathon is the main race of Ottawa Race Weekend, held in late May since 1975. It is a certified Boston Marathon qualifying course and a World Athletics Elite Label race. The marathon starts at Ottawa City Hall.
courseHighlights: Start at Ottawa City Hall on Laurier Avenue West
Interactive course map with elevation profiles on the official site
Routes have used the bridges between Ottawa and Gatineau

paceStrategy.summary: Organisers describe the recent course as flat, so even pacing should work. The course has changed over the years, so check the current map for bridges and exposed sections before you plan splits.

segments.advice: Start at goal pace or slightly slower; the 7:00 start can be cool.
Keep a steady rhythm and drink at each aid station.
Use the official elevation profile to find any small rises, then save energy for them.

fuelingNotes: The official page lists Xact Nutrition and Hydration on course. Check the course map and the participant guide for aid-station positions.
tips: Read the interactive course map before race day: it shows road closures and the elevation profile
The start is at Ottawa City Hall at 7:00
Late May can be warm, so plan fluids and a hat
The route has changed in some years (for example after a bridge closure forced changes), so re-check the map each year

faq.question: Is the Ottawa Marathon course flat?
faq.answer: Organisers and event listings describe a flat, fast course. Use the interactive map on the official site to see the elevation profile for the current route.

faq.question: When is the Ottawa Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in late May, as part of Ottawa Race Weekend.

faq.question: Where does the Ottawa Marathon start?
faq.answer: It starts at Ottawa City Hall, 110 Laurier Avenue West.
